material.acceptance_criteria: With two pages joining in either order, an answer event (kind 30078, d-tag ending :answer) appears on the relay and the data channel opens, or the offerer re-offers after a bounded timeout; verified by querying the relay for answer events.
material.commit_comment: Fix 2686246e in wireweave src/data.js; parent pin b73c0673 (ci run 40100124724 success). Parent commit fb83995a removed the gitlink; restored by b73c0673. Browser two-profile answer event not witnessed (acceptance alternative used).
material.description: Reproduced with a local mirror (http://127.0.0.1:8899) and wireweave's EphemeralRelay on ws://127.0.0.1:43199: guest published an offer (ts 1792692242978), host joined afterwards, and the host's __ciDebug (?ci=1) shows two peer connections both ice="new", conn="new", remoteMdns=0 — peers created from presence, but no SDP ever applied and no answer published. The offer is one-shot: once missed, neither side re-offers, so both sit at 'peers 0 (local)' indefinitely. data.js:_handleSignal answers offers via doAnswer, but nothing re-sends an offer when the peer never answers.
material.subject: WebRTC offer is never retried, so a join-order race leaves both peers at 'peers 0 (local)'
material.witness: Node witness on the real DataSession (wireweave src/data.js, HEAD 4e32beb pre-fix vs 2686246e post-fix; fake RTCPeerConnection, fake relay pool). Offers published per sample, t=0/4.6/24.6/29.2s: pre no-answer [1,1,1,1], post no-answer [1,2,6,6] (one re-offer per 4s, bounded at 5). Answer applied at 4.6s: pre [1,1,1], post [1,2,2] (no re-offer after the answer). Pinned in parent by b73c0673 (CI ci run 40100124724 success).
